name: Hitboxes
author: irongete
description: Three modes for the footprint of every game object in view -- and of the building you are placing: off, a blue patch laid on the terrain and hidden by whatever stands in front of it, and the same patch told the world may not hide it -- so a box inside a house or over a hill is drawn whole, while your windows still cover it. Options > AddOns > Hitboxes picks the mode and sets the look: the fill's colour and opacity, and the border's colour and thickness. The key assigned in Options > Keybindings > Hitboxes cycles the modes; every row is remembered.
